signals.title: llama-modchip: run a 284B DeepSeek model on 64GB RAM with no GPU
signals.summary: Open-source project memory-maps a 284B-parameter model to run on ordinary consumer RAM with zero GPU, hit #6 on HN front page (442pt/196c).
signals.run_with_it_note: Clone it on a spare machine (the Intel loop box or mbp-2) and benchmark a real local-inference job from your stack (caption drafts, log triage) against the API cost of the same job this week.

signals.title: OpenRouter's new Auto Code router: Opus 5.5-level coding quality at 74% less cost
signals.summary: OpenRouter shipped a next-gen Auto Router plus a coding-specific Auto Code router that picks the cheapest model meeting a quality bar per request; OpenRouter claims Opus-5.5-level output at 74% lower cost on its benchmarks.
signals.run_with_it_note: Point one cheap, high-volume background loop (an Idea Radar pass or a Slack summarizer) at openrouter/auto-code for a week and diff cost and output quality against what it runs on today.

signals.title: 85% of AEO wins happen offsite, not on your own pages
signals.summary: A GTM-strategy writeup argues most answer-engine-optimization gains come from third-party mentions (creators, review sites) rather than owned-site content, with creator relationships as the underused lever.
signals.run_with_it_note: This is the unlock for the stalled AI-citation loop (memory: project_ai_citation_loop never produced a check). Pick one brand, list the 5 highest-authority third-party sites/creators that could mention it, and pitch 2 this week.

signals.title: "Why wouldn't the labs do it?" — physical ops and proprietary data are the real AI-lab moat
signals.summary: Essay argues AI labs now threaten most pure-software startups, so the defensible ground left is physical operations, proprietary data, and regulated workflows, exactly where tour/hospitality operators sit.

signals.title: Stripe lets you point Claude or Cursor straight at your Stripe data
signals.summary: Stripe customers can now connect an agent (Claude, Cursor) directly to their payments data to explain revenue swings, with the underlying SQL shown for verification.

signals.title: Expedia goes live inside Meta's Muse agent
signals.summary: Expedia's booking integration into Meta's consumer AI agent Muse is live; Skift finds its real AI wins are still mostly inside Expedia's own apps, not the agent surface.

signals.title: Cloudflare ships a trust/identity framework for AI agents hitting websites
signals.summary: As AI agents act on users' behalf, sites can't verify agent identity or trustworthiness; Cloudflare's new framework plus a hashed-user-ID scheme aims to let sites charge and account for agent traffic.

signals.title: Kino AI (YC S23): an AI media manager and video editor launches on HN
signals.summary: YC-backed Kino AI launched an AI-driven media manager/video editor aimed at creators handling large raw-footage libraries.

signals.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber, an autonomous vulnerability-finding model
signals.summary: OpenAI's cybersecurity-focused model finds and validates exploitable vulnerabilities within researcher-set limits.

signals.title: Thinking Machines launches Inkling 2 Small, a 594B MoE multimodal model
signals.summary: 594B-param (17B active) mixture-of-experts model takes image inputs; closed weights via Tinker now, full weights planned under Apache 2.0 after safety testing.

signals.title: Rivet (YC W23): orchestrate AI agents at scale on S3
signals.summary: YC-backed launch for scaling and orchestrating many AI agents using S3 as the backing store, HN front-page traction (120pt/59c).

signals.title: Climate-tech seed subwatch quiet a fourth straight week
signals.summary: No climate-tech seed round dated to this week turned up again; the subwatch has found nothing fresh for 4 weeks running. Worth asking David whether to keep this lens on.

signals.title: Broad seed-stage HN queries came back empty this week
signals.summary: "Seed round raised," "indie hacker new product," and "new AI model release capability" HN queries all returned zero hits >20pts in the last 7 days; only YC launch-tagged queries (Rivet, Kino AI) surfaced anything.

signals.title: Wikipedia interest: 'LLM'/'AI agent' pageviews cooling, 'Venture capital'/'Seed money' ticking up
signals.summary: 30-day pageview trend: Large_language_model -18%, AI_agent -24% week-over-week vs. first week of the window; Venture_capital +7%, Seed_money +20%. Mild, not yet a story.
